digest.component_or_area: documentation generation tooling and config reference
propositions: A new generator script must synthesize config-reference.md and security.md from typed config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory, leaving docs/config.md untouched and preserving all its existing consumers.
The generated docs must include curated narrative topics (precedence, observability, subprocess limits, behavior deltas, native refresh) verbatim from a template constant, not synthesized.
A --check drift mode must detect staleness in generated docs via newline-normalized comparison, run under make test without CI dependency, and be validated by a pytest suite.
Both generated docs must carry a self-announcing banner within the first 8 lines naming the generator command, and be registered in the parity gate (GENERATED map and README table).

Topic coverage must be proven by test: every entry in a REQUIRED_TOPICS list (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) must have a corresponding anchor/heading across both generated docs.
Preservation of docs/config.md and all its content-asserting test consumers must be proven by a test asserting the generator never targets config.md.
